_README: WHAT THIS GAME PLAYS, STATED AS DATA. Dawnblade is a fan-made sub-format
of Flesh and Blood's Silver Age, declared by the project owner on
2026-09-26. Its pool is FROZEN at the fifteen Chapter 1-3 precons as
printed, and it does NOT follow Silver Age's rolling ban list or its
seasonal hero bench: a card Silver Age has since banned, or a hero it has
benched, stays legal here. That is a choice about which game this is, not
THE SILVER AGE LEGALITY BLOCK IS `null`, AND THAT IS A STATEMENT.
Recording which pool cards Silver Age has banned needs the official
announcements, and every source for them was blocked by this project's
cloud sandbox on 2026-09-26. An empty list would read as 'nothing is
banned', which is false; `null` reads as 'not yet recorded'. The research
is a desktop task (DESKTOP-TASKS.md). When it is done, fill `banned` and
`benched` with sourced entries; the drill checks every name against the
pool, so a typo fails rather than silently marking nothing.

dawnblade.name: Dawnblade
dawnblade.kind: a fan-made sub-format of Silver Age
dawnblade.pool: the fifteen Silver Age Chapter 1-3 preconstructed decks exactly as printed (window.DECKS), plus the tokens and Demi-Heroes their cards create
dawnblade.legality: every card and every hero in the pool is legal, whatever Silver Age's own ban list or hero bench says
dawnblade.rules: the Flesh and Blood Comprehensive Rules as this engine encodes them; every stated deviation is a record in tools/approx.js

_why: Silver Age's legality is recorded BESIDE the format, never inside it:
it is information a player may want (which of these cards would they
not be allowed at a Silver Age event) and it changes every season, while
silverAge.pending: desktop task — see DESKTOP-TASKS.md, 'Silver Age legality'
